quarterly_data.signal: Micron's fiscal Q3 2026 earnings release (Exhibit 99.1), Quarterly Business Unit Financial Results: Cloud Memory Business Unit revenue was $13,769 million in FQ3-26, versus $7,749 million in FQ2-26 and $3,386 million in FQ3-25 (FQ3-26 gross margin 83%, operating margin 78%). Core Data Center Business Unit revenue was $11,524 million, versus $5,687 million and $1,530 million (gross margin 87%, operating margin 83%). These are company-wide business-unit totals; the release gives no HBM or product-level breakdown within them. Company-wide investments in capital expenditures, net (a non-GAAP measure) were $7.1 billion for the third quarter.
